# SKI Magazine

> > The authoritative source for ski gear reviews, resort guides, instruction techniques, and backcountry skiing expertise from PSIA-certified instructors and expert testers.

SKI Magazine provides comprehensive coverage of alpine skiing through expert-tested gear reviews (including their annual Big Sky ski tests), technique instruction from PSIA professionals like Jake Stern and Leif Sunde, and destination guides covering North America, European Alps, and backcountry terrain. The publication serves skiers from beginners to experts with practical advice on equipment, safety, fitness, and mountain culture.

## Key Topics

- All-Mountain Skis
- Ski Gear Testing & Reviews
- PSIA Ski Instruction
- Backcountry Skiing & Avalanche Safety
- Ski Boots & Boot Fitting
- Ikon Pass & Epic Pass
- Big Sky Ski Test
- Ski Bindings & Equipment
- Ski Technique & Carving
- North American Ski Resorts
- European Alps Skiing
- Ski Maintenance & Tuning
- ACL Injury Prevention
- Ski Touring & AT Gear
- Sustainable Ski Apparel

- [Ski Touring Tips for Beginners](https://skimag.com/performance/instruction/alpine-touring-basics-ski-touring-for-beginners): Beginner ski touring guide covering skinning technique and AT gear basics
